expectations.text: Anchors the offer band to Glassdoor's tech-industry cut, on the grounds the hire is in-house at a tech company.
expectations.evidence: The response anchors to Glassdoor's national average for Event Marketing Manager ($100,135) instead of the tech-industry cut: "Put $100,000 base on the req... Glassdoor's national average." It treats the IT-industry figure ($175,690) only as a "ceiling, not a base-salary benchmark." It says to use that figure "only if Ledgerpoint is benchmarked as a tech employer." It does not assume the hire is in-house at a tech company and leaves that question to HR. The rubric item is therefore violated.
